diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
diseases.breed_note: No reliable breed-specific difference is being used in this assessment.
diseases.age_note: Young calves are more likely to show severe symptoms and need faster referral.

diseases.name: Mastitis
diseases.breed_note: High-yield dairy breeds are more prone to mastitis and may need closer monitoring.
diseases.age_note: No reliable age-specific difference is being used in this assessment.

diseases.name: Blackleg
diseases.breed_note: No reliable breed-specific difference is being used in this assessment.
diseases.age_note: Young, fast-growing animals (6-24 months) are at higher risk.

diseases.name: Newcastle Disease
diseases.breed_note: No reliable breed-specific difference is being used in this assessment.
diseases.age_note: Young birds tend to show more severe nervous signs and higher mortality.
